data.one_liner: Flutter implementation of Google's libphonenumber for parsing and formatting phone numbers.
data.what_it_does: This plugin provides a Flutter interface to Google's libphonenumber library. It allows you to parse phone numbers, get region info, get number types, and format numbers as you type.
use_when: You need to parse and format international phone numbers in a Flutter app
You need to validate phone number inputs and determine their type
avoid_when: You need advanced features from libphonenumber that are not yet exposed by this limited plugin implementation
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS
strengths: Supports null safety and v2 Android embedding
Wraps Google's well-known libphonenumber library for mobile platforms
weaknesses: Includes only a few features at the moment
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS)
data.setup_notes: Standard Flutter plugin setup for Android and iOS.
